articles.title: Minecraft's First New Dimension in 15 Years Comes With Blue Bunnies
articles.summary: Minecraft Live revealed The Sift, the game's first new dimension since The End in 2011. It arrives first in Minecraft Dungeons II on September 29, and it has blue bunnies. Underground ice caves are also coming.

articles.title: Fat Bear Week Returns: 16 Bears, One Very Round Crown
articles.summary: Fat Bear Week is back for its 12th year, with voting open until September 29 at Alaska's Katmai National Park. Sixteen bears are competing, including defending champ Chunk, who recovered from a broken jaw.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Unraveled Tour Blooms to Life — Dissolving Dress Included
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo launched her Unraveled Tour on September 25 in Hartford, Connecticut, with a two-hour show full of flowers, rain, confetti, and a dress that dissolved on stage. She also led the arena in singing Happy Birthday to her mom.
